app_info.subtitle: Research and usability tests
app_info.description: TheySaid helps teams explore customer feedback, analyze projects and responses, prepare and run AI usability tests, monitor progress, and review actionable findings through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists projects and their summary metadata without modifying workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses projects in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves an existing project's purpose, themes, ratings, questions, and citations.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses research data in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change or remove project data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only computes an estimated completion time from an existing project's questions.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads a project in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not update the project or its questions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only calculates response and channel statistics for an existing project.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses data in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter project responses or metrics.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves recent responses for an existing project.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses responses in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or delete responses.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches and returns matching organization responses and optional conversation transcripts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only searches data in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify, archive, or delete responses.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only aggregates existing answers for one project question.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses question data in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not update the question or its answers.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the current definition and position of one question.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses a question in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not edit or reorder the question.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves an existing theme, recommendations, and supporting quotes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses research data in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change the theme or underlying responses.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only aggregates existing response volume and sentiment over time.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses project data in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter responses or stored statistics.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists organization contacts and their response summaries.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses contacts in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not edit, merge, or delete contacts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves an existing contact's details and recent responses.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses contacts in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not update or delete contact records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves an existing response, transcript, answers, themes, and respondent details.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses response data in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not edit or remove response data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves previously extracted video findings, frictions, tasks, emotions, and mental-model gaps.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses processed insight data in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify recordings or extracted metadata.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the caller organization's stored company profile.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not update company information.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists or searches the organization's existing knowledge sources.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses documents in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not upload, edit, share, or delete documents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only aggregates existing responses by collection channel.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses project data in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter responses or project channels.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only compares existing projects and their themes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses projects in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not merge, update, or delete projects.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only computes semantic similarity among existing organization projects.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses projects in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify project embeddings or project data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renders and stores a new chart image in TheySaid-managed storage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only writes to TheySaid-managed storage rather than arbitrary external services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new chart object and does not overwrite or delete existing user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only echoes a health-check message and does not change application data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only checks the connected TheySaid server.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter or remove data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates an organization-scoped upload handle and presigned write URL for a design snapshot.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only prepares an object path in TheySaid-managed storage.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a fresh upload slot and does not remove existing data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes the supplied HTML to an organization-scoped snapshot object.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only writes to TheySaid-managed storage within the caller's organization namespace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reusing an upload handle overwrites that snapshot object after validating the handle, HTML shape, and size.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only validates and analyzes an existing organization-scoped design snapshot.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads the prepared snapshot and fixed analysis services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite or delete the snapshot.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a cached, reviewable test proposal and may scan the supplied prototype.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can fetch and analyze an arbitrary public prototype URL supplied by the user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new draft proposal without launching testers or overwriting an existing project.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes a revised proposal or saves new audience settings on an existing test project.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes proposal or project data inside the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Supersedes the prior proposal or overwrites saved audience settings for the selected project.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new usability-test project, consumes tester quota, and starts AI tester jobs.
justifications.open_world_justification: AI testers navigate the arbitrary external prototype associated with the approved proposal.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new project and run without replacing an existing project.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts another tester batch on an existing project and may update its design URL.
justifications.open_world_justification: AI testers navigate the project's arbitrary external prototype.
justifications.destructive_justification: When an upload handle is supplied, it overwrites the selected project's saved design URL before starting the run.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches the external voice catalog and returns matching voice metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries the external ElevenLabs voice catalog.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, edit, purchase, or delete voices.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves progress and current findings for an existing test.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses test state in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not start, cancel, or modify the test.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only waits for and retrieves progress or results for an existing test.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses test state in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not start, cancel, or modify the test.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves synthesized findings and fix prompts for an existing test.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only accesses results in the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter test results or project data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Records an organization-scoped quality flag for a synthesized issue.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only writes feedback inside the caller's bounded TheySaid organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a flag without deleting or overwriting the underlying test result.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates and links the caller's TheySaid organization after explicit terms agreement.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only uses TheySaid and fixed account-setup integrations rather than arbitrary external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates account setup records and treats an already-onboarded caller as a no-op.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show my recently active published research projects.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching projects with titles, types, response counts, statuses, and pagination information.

test_cases.description: Inspect one project's major research findings.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me the top themes, ratings, recommendations, and supporting quotes for project p1.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a grounded project overview with themes, quantitative results, questions, and citable respondent evidence.

test_cases.description: Search for a focused set of customer responses.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find negative checkout feedback from the last 30 days and include the full conversations.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching organization responses with project context and conversation transcripts when available.

test_cases.description: Prepare a reviewable usability-test plan without launching it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Plan a quick usability test for https://example.com/checkout with first-time shoppers, but do not launch it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a proposal with personas, tasks, questions, learning goals, audience settings, and a clear statement that no test has launched.

test_cases.description: Launch a test only after explicit approval of a proposal.
test_cases.user_prompt: I reviewed proposal proposal-123 and approve starting it now.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the usability-test project, starts the approved tester run, and returns the test identifier and final plan.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with my design team tomorrow afternoon.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not manage calendars or meetings.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general public-web research.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search the web for current pricing from the top five survey platforms.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because general public-web search is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for direct source-code editing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite my React checkout component to use a two-column layout.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it analyzes research and runs tests but does not edit application source code.
